decision: Use semi-structured interviews, a versioned coding framework, analytic memos, negative-case review and a reflexivity record.
credible_alternatives: A fixed-response survey; rejected because the project asks how uncertainty is interpreted and managed, not how often predefined responses occur.
criteria: Route fit; evidence production; feasibility; ethics/rights; reversibility
evidence_and_authority: Constant comparison across accounts, deliberate search for negative cases and reflexive comparison between early and revised interpretations.
assumptions_and_risks: Researcher interpretation, sample composition, incomplete recall, social desirability and transfer beyond the teaching context.
conditional_commitment: Use semi-structured interviews, a versioned coding framework, analytic memos, negative-case review and a reflexivity record.
early_test: Pilot two interview guides and check whether prompts elicit concrete debugging episodes rather than general opinions.
reopening_trigger: A disclosure or consent defect stops use of the material; a coding change that alters the claim reopens Claim and Argument Gates.
